lore: Old bones, sleeping in a layer of dust.
use: Brush it with the Vanilla brush for about a minute to free a dinosaur egg. Pausing makes the progress run back at twice the speed. Mine it with Silk Touch to keep the block.
secret: Which egg sleeps inside depends on the place where the block was found. Mined with Silk Touch it keeps that egg wherever you set it down again.

lore: A big green egg, warm to the touch.
use: Place it and sit on it with an empty hand: 5 minutes of sitting broods it, 10 minutes later a tame T. rex hatchling hatches for the player who sat longest.
secret: Stand up too early and the warmth leaks away twice as fast as it came.

lore: A sand-colored egg with brown bands.
use: Place it and sit on it with an empty hand: 5 minutes of sitting broods it, 10 minutes later a tame Triceratops hatchling hatches for the player who sat longest. Three eggshells stay behind.
secret: Its horns are not for fighting: a charge against a tree shakes the fruit loose.

lore: A slate-gray egg with a pattern like small plates.
use: Place it and sit on it with an empty hand: 5 minutes of sitting broods it, 10 minutes later a tame Stegosaurus hatchling hatches for the player who sat longest. Three eggshells stay behind.
secret: Badlands fossils hold more of these eggs.

lore: A rust-red egg with dark speckles.
use: Place it and sit on it like every dinosaur egg: a tame Utahraptor hatches for the player who sat longest. Badlands fossils hold more of these eggs.
secret: The claws are already sharp inside.

lore: A teal egg with light dots.
use: Place it and sit on it with an empty hand: 5 minutes of sitting broods it, 10 minutes later a tame Parasaurolophus hatchling hatches for the player who sat longest. Three eggshells stay behind.
secret: Swamp fossils hold more of these eggs.

lore: A saddle made for something much bigger than a horse.
use: Use it on a tamed adult dinosaur to ride it; one rider. Shaped: a saddle in the middle, 4 leather in the corners, 4 iron ingots on the sides.
secret: A normal saddle does not fit, and this one fits no horse.

lore: Boiled leather plates, cut for a skull the size of a door.
use: Use it on a tamed adult T. rex. Protection 3, like leather horse armor. 8 leather around a bone block.
secret: The bone block in the middle is the part the T. rex likes best.

lore: Riveted iron plates for a head and a back that bite back.
use: Use it on a tamed adult T. rex. Protection 5, like iron horse armor. 8 iron ingots around a bone block.
secret: The rivets are the only part that is not heavy.

lore: Diamond plates that throw the light around the cave.
use: Use it on a tamed adult T. rex. Protection 11, like diamond horse armor. 8 diamonds around a bone block.
secret: Looks best on a green T. rex.

lore: Copper plates, warm in the sun and green in the rain.
use: Put it on a tamed, grown T. rex (plates for head and back): protection 4, like copper horse armor. 8 copper ingots around a bone block.
secret: It does not turn green on a dinosaur - they are rarely rained on long enough.

lore: Soft gold, more for the parade than for the fight.
use: Put it on a tamed, grown T. rex (plates for head and back): protection 7, like golden horse armor. 8 gold ingots around a bone block.
secret: Piglins look twice at a golden dinosaur.

lore: Rose gold, pale pink and still tougher than plain gold.
use: Put it on a tamed, grown T. rex (plates for head and back): protection 6, between iron (5) and gold (7). 8 rose gold ingots around a bone block.
secret: Silver in the alloy, so it shines a little cooler than gold.

lore: Rose copper: the cheaper alloy, copper-pink and honest.
use: Put it on a tamed, grown T. rex (plates for head and back): protection 4, like copper horse armor. 8 rose copper ingots around a bone block.
secret: More copper than rose, but nobody tells the dinosaur.

lore: Netherite plates that do not even notice lava.
use: Put it on a tamed, grown T. rex (plates for head and back): protection 19, toughness 3 and knockback resistance 0.1, like Netherite horse armor; fire resistant. Smithing table: Netherite upgrade + diamond T. rex armor + Netherite ingot.
secret: A T. rex in Netherite still floats in lava? No. Do not try.

lore: Enderite plates with a violet shimmer from the End.
use: Put it on a tamed, grown T. rex (plates for head and back): protection 22, toughness 4 and knockback resistance 0.2, one step above Netherite; fire resistant. Smithing table: Enderite upgrade + Netherite T. rex armor + Enderite ingot (with Simple Ores).
secret: The strongest armor a T. rex can wear.

lore: A frill shield of stitched leather with soft horn caps.
use: Put it on a grown, tamed Triceratops: protection like leather horse armor. Eight leather around a Triceratops eggshell.
secret: The horn caps make a charge look twice as brave.

lore: A riveted iron frill shield with three horn caps.
use: Put it on a grown, tamed Triceratops: protection like iron horse armor. Eight iron ingots around a Triceratops eggshell.
secret: The trees do not mind the clang, the Triceratops does not either.

lore: A faceted diamond frill shield that catches the light.
use: Put it on a grown, tamed Triceratops: protection like diamond horse armor. Eight diamonds around a Triceratops eggshell.
secret: The recipe only shows once you hold an eggshell, like the turtle shell after the scute.

lore: Soft gold, more for the parade than for the fight.
use: Put it on a tamed, grown Triceratops (a frill shield with three horn caps): protection 7, like golden horse armor. 8 gold ingots around a Triceratops eggshell.
secret: Piglins look twice at a golden dinosaur.

lore: Rose gold, pale pink and still tougher than plain gold.
use: Put it on a tamed, grown Triceratops (a frill shield with three horn caps): protection 6, between iron (5) and gold (7). 8 rose gold ingots around a Triceratops eggshell.
secret: Silver in the alloy, so it shines a little cooler than gold.

lore: Rose copper: the cheaper alloy, copper-pink and honest.
use: Put it on a tamed, grown Triceratops (a frill shield with three horn caps): protection 4, like copper horse armor. 8 rose copper ingots around a Triceratops eggshell.
secret: More copper than rose, but nobody tells the dinosaur.

lore: Boiled leather for a neck and two flanks, with gaps for the plates.
use: Put it on a grown, tamed Stegosaurus: protection like leather horse armor. Eight leather around a Stegosaurus eggshell.
secret: The plates on its back need no armor: they are its own.

lore: Riveted iron flank plates and a neck guard.
use: Put it on a grown, tamed Stegosaurus: protection like iron horse armor. Eight iron ingots around a Stegosaurus eggshell.
secret: The plow does not care how shiny its puller is.

lore: Diamond flank plates that glitter between the back plates.
use: Put it on a grown, tamed Stegosaurus: protection like diamond horse armor. Eight diamonds around a Stegosaurus eggshell.
secret: Even the tail spikes look a little jealous.

lore: Soft gold, more for the parade than for the fight.
use: Put it on a tamed, grown Stegosaurus (a neck guard and flank plates): protection 7, like golden horse armor. 8 gold ingots around a Stegosaurus eggshell.
secret: Piglins look twice at a golden dinosaur.

lore: Rose gold, pale pink and still tougher than plain gold.
use: Put it on a tamed, grown Stegosaurus (a neck guard and flank plates): protection 6, between iron (5) and gold (7). 8 rose gold ingots around a Stegosaurus eggshell.
secret: Silver in the alloy, so it shines a little cooler than gold.

lore: Rose copper: the cheaper alloy, copper-pink and honest.
use: Put it on a tamed, grown Stegosaurus (a neck guard and flank plates): protection 4, like copper horse armor. 8 rose copper ingots around a Stegosaurus eggshell.
secret: More copper than rose, but nobody tells the dinosaur.

lore: Three iron shares on a beam, far too heavy for a horse.
use: The owner puts it on a grown Stegosaurus (right click); shears take it off. Ride with a saddle and press the jump key: the plow goes down and tills three blocks wide like a hoe, where you may build. Seeds in your off hand are sown on the way. 750 durability, repaired with iron ingots.
secret: Unbreaking and Mending work on it like on any tool.

lore: A soft leather hood for the crest and a blanket for the hips.
use: Put it on a grown, tamed Parasaurolophus: protection like leather horse armor. Eight leather around a Parasaurolophus eggshell.
secret: The hood leaves the crest open at the end, so the call still rings.

lore: An iron crest hood and a riveted hip blanket.
use: Put it on a grown, tamed Parasaurolophus: protection like iron horse armor. Eight iron ingots around a Parasaurolophus eggshell.
secret: The herd follows the call, not the shine.

lore: A diamond crest hood that sparkles when it calls.
use: Put it on a grown, tamed Parasaurolophus: protection like diamond horse armor. Eight diamonds around a Parasaurolophus eggshell.
secret: Cows are not impressed. Sheep a little.

lore: Soft gold, more for the parade than for the fight.
use: Put it on a tamed, grown Parasaurolophus (a crest hood and a hip blanket): protection 7, like golden horse armor. 8 gold ingots around a Parasaurolophus eggshell.
secret: Piglins look twice at a golden dinosaur.

lore: Rose gold, pale pink and still tougher than plain gold.
use: Put it on a tamed, grown Parasaurolophus (a crest hood and a hip blanket): protection 6, between iron (5) and gold (7). 8 rose gold ingots around a Parasaurolophus eggshell.
secret: Silver in the alloy, so it shines a little cooler than gold.

lore: Rose copper: the cheaper alloy, copper-pink and honest.
use: Put it on a tamed, grown Parasaurolophus (a crest hood and a hip blanket): protection 4, like copper horse armor. 8 rose copper ingots around a Parasaurolophus eggshell.
secret: More copper than rose, but nobody tells the dinosaur.

lore: A leather neck guard, a stitched chest plate and two shin guards.
use: Put it on a grown, tamed Utahraptor: protection like leather horse armor. Eight leather around a Utahraptor eggshell.
secret: The sickle claws stay free - it still climbs.

lore: An iron neck guard, a riveted chest plate and two shin guards.
use: Put it on a grown, tamed Utahraptor: protection like iron horse armor. Eight iron ingots around a Utahraptor eggshell.
secret: The sickle claws stay free - it still climbs.

lore: A diamond neck guard, a faceted chest plate and two shin guards.
use: Put it on a grown, tamed Utahraptor: protection like diamond horse armor. Eight diamonds around a Utahraptor eggshell.
secret: The sickle claws stay free - it still climbs.

lore: Soft gold, more for the parade than for the fight.
use: Put it on a tamed, grown Utahraptor (a neck guard, a chest plate and shin guards): protection 7, like golden horse armor. 8 gold ingots around a Utahraptor eggshell.
secret: Piglins look twice at a golden dinosaur.

lore: Rose gold, pale pink and still tougher than plain gold.
use: Put it on a tamed, grown Utahraptor (a neck guard, a chest plate and shin guards): protection 6, between iron (5) and gold (7). 8 rose gold ingots around a Utahraptor eggshell.
secret: Silver in the alloy, so it shines a little cooler than gold.

lore: Rose copper: the cheaper alloy, copper-pink and honest.
use: Put it on a tamed, grown Utahraptor (a neck guard, a chest plate and shin guards): protection 4, like copper horse armor. 8 rose copper ingots around a Utahraptor eggshell.
secret: More copper than rose, but nobody tells the dinosaur.

lore: A long brown feather with dark bands.
use: Brush a grown Utahraptor with a brush: one raptor feather, then it needs 10 minutes. One raptor feather crafts into three feathers.
secret: Arrows without a chicken farm.

lore: Half a shell, still warm from the hatchling.
use: Three fall when a Triceratops hatches. One makes three bone meal; one in the middle of eight leather, iron or diamonds makes Triceratops armor.
secret: No Triceratops, no shell: the armor waits for the first hatchling.

lore: Half a slate-gray shell with plate marks.
use: Falls when a Stegosaurus hatches; one makes three bone meal. Eight leather, iron ingots or diamonds around it make Stegosaurus armor.
secret: Hold one and the plow recipe shows up too.

lore: Half a rust-red shell with dark speckles.
use: Falls when a Utahraptor hatches (three of them); one makes three bone meal. The middle of the Utahraptor armor recipes.
secret: Holding it unlocks the Utahraptor armor recipes, like a turtle scute does for the turtle shell.

lore: Half a teal shell with light dots.
use: Falls when a Parasaurolophus hatches; one makes three bone meal. Eight leather, iron ingots or diamonds around it make Parasaurolophus armor.
secret: The armor recipes show up once you hold one.

lore: A field notebook for the finds under the sand.
use: The Simple Dinosaurs Guide explains the fossil block, the eggs and the T. rex. Craft it shapeless from a book and a bone.
secret: Its pages open in your language and nothing is consumed.
